proposal.summary: The report describes an unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) against Pega Platform (on-premise) 8.1.0 through 8.3.7 via an exposed Java RMI/JMX interface using the MOGWAI LABS JMX Exploitation Toolkit to install an MBean and execute commands.
proposal.cwe_quote: Installing mbean for remote code execution

AV.quote: Exploitation requires: - JVM - MOGWAI LABS JMX Exploitation Toolkit (https://github.com/mogwailabs/mjet) - jython

AC.quote: Exploitation requires: - JVM - MOGWAI LABS JMX Exploitation Toolkit (https://github.com/mogwailabs/mjet) - jython
